children.value: Euclidean space, with vectors of coordinates, is often the first example of a vector space that a student meets. But on its own, it doesn’t quite demonstrate the power behind this construction. The real motivation for the study of vector spaces comes from the fact that many more abstract sets, like the set of differentiable functions or the set of matrices, can be considered as vector spaces.
